Plain Language Summary for Concrete Batch Plant Standard Permit 
Application for Concrete Batch Plant Standard Permit Registration Number 173154L003 
The following summary is provided for this pending air permit application being reviewed by the Texas 
Commission on Environmental Quality as required by 30 Texas Administrative Code Chapter 3. The 
information provided in this summary may change during the technical review of the application and are not 
federal enforceable representations of the permit application. 
Amrize South Central Inc. (CN603943606) has submitted an application to register a temporary concrete batch 
plant under the Air Quality Standard Permit for Concrete Batch Plants for registration number 173154L003. 
The concrete batch plant (RN111758827) will be located at, Heading South on US-67, take exit toward Railport 
and Miller Road. Turn right on to Miller Road and go ~1.8 miles on Miller Road. The location will be on the 
right, Midlothian, Ellis County. 
This registration will authorize the concrete batch plant to have a maximum production rate of 200 cubic yards 
per hour of concrete and operate up to 8,760 hours per year. Particulate matter will be emitted from the 
handling of aggregate, cement, and flyash. Roads and traffic areas will be controlled by watering them to 
control dust. Dust from stockpiles will be minimized by watering. Enclosures and baghouses will be used to 
control cement and flyash dust.
